patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero sections with large, impactful typography and a dominant graphic element that dynamically shifts position and scale.
Headings use a very bold, wide sans-serif font, often with a mix of black and a vibrant orange for emphasis on key words, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of stark white, deep black, and a single vibrant orange accent color is used throughout for text, graphics, and calls to action.
A large, abstract circular arrow graphic dynamically reveals, scales, and repositions as the user scrolls, transforming from a background element to a central framing device for new hero text.
Key content sections are introduced with large, centered, bold headings, often followed by a visual metaphor or a structured list of benefits/steps.

technique_notes: The primary scroll-triggered motion involves a large SVG or canvas-rendered graphic that animates its scale, position, and potentially its form as the user scrolls down the page, creating a dynamic visual narrative. This likely leverages a scroll animation library like GSAP ScrollTrigger, potentially combined with canvas or Lottie for the graphic rendering. Sections below the hero appear with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
The navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining access to key links. A persistent cookie consent banner is anchored to the bottom right.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, and wide sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) with a strong visual presence, contrasted with smaller, highly legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all interactive elements like buttons and input fields, contributing to a modern, crisp aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in hero sections and around large graphics, transitioning to a more balanced density in content sections with structured lists and grids.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the highly dynamic, scroll-driven transformation of the large orange circular arrow graphic, which acts as a central visual motif, evolving and reframing the core message as the user scrolls. This creates a strong sense of motion and engagement beyond typical static hero sections.
